book.name: Luk
book.title: Luk Lukho Fatmata ogepma irim togoc

content: Yudasho Yesu amna dugohon oburodec sicsichontha yongkoing yogoc
Oro, nacno sowarango yisno muno nocnoc bongono ‘Pasowa’ yongidangma worocho urop engfomtogoc.
Tuna öret socsoc böchon amna dugo orin nongoru gendic fandat fandat amna yu Yesu wot omom toctochon uyapha dabigung mahong suraroho Yesuha toup kombigungmaha tongga yu suraroha botogung.
Tuna dogu kopotho Yudashon irotnon ohogoc. Yudashon mano au wömai Iskariot ihoroc yongidung. Yui Yesuhon youp amnani 12hon toropdecma.

Dogu kopotho yuho irotnon ohuna Yudas yu öret socsoc böchon amna dugo orin öret socsoc böchon tawa amnahon ofisa yuot ongmuna ‘tingting sinom tongga Yesu yuhon oburodec siantat’ yongo worochon mata inun ganun togung.
Tuna Yuda nanohon amna moröma yu Yudasha irot ogep morö kombingo wöngnacnoha ‘möneng au gamontamon’ yongo yong koing mata inogung.
Ihoroc yuya Yudasho ‘öc’ yongo ingoroc kombigoc: ‘Yesu inogon idina wömai nocho ogep yu ayamphon oburodec tong siangot,’ ihoroc kombingga gön tongga idoc.
Yesuhon youp amnanin yaiho kumbong imu nocnochontha tong arangarang togomoroc
Oro urop nacno sowarango yisno muno, ‘Pasowa’, woroc nocnochon bongono idoc. Bongono wocin wömai Israel nanoho bot sipsip beracno dongga sonongidung.
Worocha tongga Yesuho Pita orin Jön youp imongga inogoc, “Sot ongmunya ‘Pasowa’ nacno noni tong arangarang tarun.”
Ihoroc inuna amna yaimaho Yesu inogomoroc, “‘Nacno noni nahe sinom tong arangarang toda’ yongo kombiharoc?”
Ihoroc yunya Yesuho inogoc, “Sot Yerusalem onguya amna auho yamuc urengno sumbotmuna engo uyapdec kaun feantac. Kaun feuna sot amna woroc tan tongunya yuho böc nahenne öantacan sot wocegon öarun.
Öngga böc morömo ingoroc inarun: ‘Fandat fandat amnaho yac, Nocot youp amnanaiot non Pasowa nacno nahenne naantamon?’

Ihoroc inunya böc morömpho böc irotno moröma au kindaantac. Böc irotno worocho nucno koroc itac. Wocin wömai nacno nocnoc abam manomano ambarac idang. Tuna sodu woce ongmunya nacno noni tong arangarang tarun.”
Yesuho Pita orin Jön ihoroc inuna yu ongga angmunya manomano Yesuho yogocma worochon torocgon idoc. Tuna yu nacno woce tong arangarang togomoroc.
Yesuho youp amnani kumbong imu song imogoc
Oro urop nacno nocnoc bongono fomtongga idina Yesuot youp amnani 12ot yu ongga nacno nocnoc abamdec omoc idung.
Tongo Yesuho youp amnani ingoroc inogoc, “Noc banac banac nacno Pasowa ngo sonot nocnocha toup kombihat. Mit wömai focfoc moröma nocdec öngkuantac.
Kombiarut, nocho nacno ngo wönggon manai edeya ongga Kopotorochon mom toborucno engfauna nacno ngorochon boinno öngkung tangtang tangoc.”
Yesuho ihoroc yongga wain kap sogitmuna Kopotorocha ecec inongo yogoc, “Soni ngo nongga docno nuc soniha imuya docno docno naarut.
Kombiarut, nocho wain yamuc wönggon manai edeya ongga Kopotorochon mom toborucno engfaangoc.”

Ihoroc inongga wönggon nacno sowarango au sogitmuna Kopotorocha ecec inongo uboto youp amnani silip tong imongga inogoc, “Ngoi nochon godip föbna. Nocho itonggongna son tongfat keckecha ima faantac. Mit wömai sonu nacno ngo nongmuya nocha kombiu fudöngengac.”

Ihoroc yongo imuna nacno nongbödeuya Yesuho wönggon wain kap sogitmuna yogoc, “Wain yamuc ngo woi nochon nogotna. Worocho wömai son tong fat keckecha koringma möcmöcyi. Woi Kopotorocho sonot botup botup wego sigocma worochon weran.
“Worochoi oro amna au ngocin itacmaho noc tongo ayamnaihon oburodec siantac. Yu woi nocot nacno nocnoc abamdec ngocin kondong idamot.
Kopotorocho wömai osucgon ‘ayampho noc tu omentat’ yongo kombingdegoc mahong amna wo noc ayamnaihon oburodec siantacma yu wömai mepmo moröma inobarac sinom aun feangoc.”
Yesuho ihoroc inuna youp amnani mata woroc kombingga soroc yongmuya nucno foring yaun tongo yogung, “Nonidecma numaho sinom wömai toroc kiap wontucmuno ihorocno tun?”
Yesuhon youp amnani yu ‘numaho amna moröma itac’ yongo mataho emoc togung
Oro ihoroc yongga Yesuhon youp amnani yu ‘inoin toropdecma numaho amna moröma sinom itac’ yongo mataho emoc togung.

Ihoroc tuya Yesuho inogoc, “Bumbumyi nanohon king yu suraro moröm tong imongmuya mepmo morö tong imongidang. O ihorocgon gavmanthon amna moröma yu inoha borongdeda yongidang: ‘Nonu suraro ogepma sinom tongfat yengidamon yo’.

Wohong sonu toroc kiap ihoroc tongitninga. Muno sinom, sonotma amna auho amna moröma idita kombinggai wömai yu suraroho unenne itmuna yuhon mepmono sumboda edengac. O amna auho ‘nocu dugo soni itat’ yongo moröm tong kamoc kamocha tonggai wömai yu son mongorec tong kampun.

“Tingting oro, numaho woi moröma? Amna nacno nongo itacmaha woha amna mongorec tong imongga nacno feng imongitacma yu worochu? Woi ingoroc, ‘amna nacno nongga itacma yu woi moröma’ ihoroc yongo kombingidamon mahong nocu ihoroc matongitat. Muno, nocho sonot itmaina youp amna soni iditat.
“Oro mepmo koböcmaho nocdec öngkung namongidung mahong sonu nocot itongmuya noc maimu fadot.
Worocha wömai woroc, nocho gesö kamoya sonu mom toboruchon owi amna entang. Nandöngnaho ‘noc mom midim sabarac sahon Morömo itiwa’ yongo gesö namogoc. Tuna nocho son worochon gesö kamoya
son ambaracho woce itmuya nocot nacno kondong nanahamon. O ihorocgon sonu amna morömahon abam sogitmuya Israel nanohon toropmo 12 woroc yangtorenahing,” Yesuho youp amnani ihoroc inogoc.
Yesuho ‘Pita möp yong namangoc’ yongo yong tuctuc yogoc
Oro mit Yesuho Pita yong tuctuc mata ingoroc inogoc, “Saimon Saimon! Kombiharoc, dogu kopot yu sonthon kombing tobic tobicsoni toroc toctocha Kopotoroc inong ac tuna Kopotorocho yu kombing imogoc.
Wohong nocho ‘gocha’ yongo Kopotoroc dönac inoya gochon kombing tobic tobicaho koing songga mamong wic. Muno, oipmonu wömai gocho wönggon ibari fauna nocot engmina oröcai tong koing tong imangoroc.”
Yesuho Pita ihoroc inuna Pitaho yogoc, “Moröma, noc gocot yi bucin onggongahu o gocot omomphahu imong dot matit.”

Pitaho ihoroc yuna Yesuho inogoc, “Pita, nocho boinno sinom gantiwa, önga kumbong ngocin fup mano abe mayi idina gocu nocha bongo anfi möp yongga yontaroc, ‘Nocu yu makombing imot yo,’” Yesuho Pita yong tuctucno ihoroc inogoc.
Yesuho youp amnani ‘gobit bainat wöarut’ yongo inogoc

Oro mit Yesuho youp amnani ingoroc inong ac togoc, “Osuc wömai nocho son youp toctocha kanong muaya sontho mönenghu o yoctechu o orung tomsonihu muno komong sinom onggung. Oro bongono wocin sonu yapmu auha docmögunga woha muno?” Yesuho ihoroc inuna youp amnani mata wo kombingga ‘muno’ yogung, “yapmu auha madocmögomon”.

Ihoroc yuya Yesuho inogoc, “Oro önga wömai nocho kiapmo au ingoroc kantiwa: Son muyu mönengsonihu o yoctecsonihu wo fogida ongorut. O son gobit bainatsoni maidkamuyai son muyu ongga sum tecsoni mönengha fingmuya urago gobit bainatsoni wöarut.

Wömai yaha, Kopotorochon bapiyadec nocha yong tuctuc mata irim toctocyi itacma worocho boinno entacmaha: ‘Owi amnaho yuha kombiantang, yu wontucmuno toctoc amna.’ (Aisaia 53:12) “Oro yong tuctuc mata ngorocho wömai urop nocdec boinno öngkup öngkupha tac.”
Yesuho ihoroc yuna youp amnaniho inogung, “Moröma ngo ahi, gobit bainat yai idamoroc.” Ihoroc yuya Yesuho yogoc, “Oro, urop.”
Yesuho sa urongo mano Oliv woce dönac youp togoc
Oro mit Yesuho Yerusalem imun fauna Oliv sa urongodec ögoc. Osuc tongidocma worochon torocgon tongga uuna youp amnani yu tan tonggung.
Sa urongodec öngkungmuya Yesuho youp amnani inogoc, “Sonu dönac youp tarut. Tonguc keckec sonidec öngkuicyit.”
Ihoroc inongo inoi korungon bum amnaho sop monidangmahon toroc ihoroc ohongga ito goruc yemoc tongo Kopotorocha dönac ingoroc inogoc,
“Nandöngna, goc ogep focfoc morö nocdec öngkuantacma wo tui dehun. Wohong nochon kombic kombic muno, gakain irotgon koing soun.”
Yu dönac ihoroc yongo idina momdecma yaru auho yuot ohongga tongkoing tong imogoc.
Tuna Yesuho irot mepmep toup tongmuna dönac youp orongi sinom tuna nepho nogot simbang oririp ohongo gurocdec ohogoc.
Oro dönac yongbödengga idongga youp amnaniot ongga yagocmai yu ambarac kombingbanac toup togung-maha dungga idung.
Dungga idiya Yesuho inogoc,” Son yaöha dubang yo. Son idongmuya dönac youp tarut. Tonguc keckecho soni sogiuna möng kahicyit.”
Yudasho Yesu tawa amnaho oburodec sigoc

Yesuho youp amnani mata ihoroc inongga idina urop amna torop morö engmuya amna mano Yudas worocho osuc fato uyap sing imogoc. Yudas yui youp amna 12hon toropdecma. Yu Yesuot engmuna Yesu ducin ducin tong imogoc.
Ihoroc tuna Yesuho inogoc, “Yudas, goc Amnahon Manano ducin ducin tong weran tia ayamnaiho noc sogit akep tontanghu nuhun?”
Ihoroc inuna Yesuhon youp amnaniho yagungmai tawa amnaho urop Yesu sogit sogita togung. Tongo yu Yesu inogung, “Moröma, gocho yia nontho gobitdec dopna.”
Ihoroc yongmuya urop youp amna auho gobitno sogitmuna öret socsoc amna morömahon youp wabkarac au woto onggimo arocnema wo saringmun möng imogoc.
Ihoroc tuna Yesuho woroc angga yogoc, “Urop, imi fahun!” Ihoroc yongga ongmuna youp wabkarachon onggimo tun orokogoc.

Tongo yu amna ebungma ingoroc inogoc, “Tingting oro, nocu emoc amna muno. Worocha tingtinga sinom sonu gopit bainat orin kando yongga febang yo? Sepno sepno wömai nocho öret socsoc bucin soniot itongidot mahong sonu noc sogit akep matogung. Wohong sonu yagunohon fat muno, worocha woroc son kumbong ebangma,” Yesu yu ihoroc inogoc. Oro amna ebungma woi öret socsochon amna dugo orin öret socsoc böchon tawa amna worochon ofisa orin surarohon amna dugo yu ambarac ‘Yesu sogitna’ yongo ebung.
Pitaho Yesu möp yong imogoc
Tuna tawa amnaho Yesu sogida öret socsoc amna morömaho bucin yangat tonggung. Yangat tonguya Pitaho obmukusuc korungon bum ida yu yan fonggoc.
Yan fonguna tawa amnaho böc worochon gomboin ep tobing songga idiya Pitaho yuot onguna ambarac wocin idung.
Tuna mongorec toctoc owi auho Pita among fihic tongo yogoc, “Amna ngo, yu ihorocgon Yesuot itongidoc.”
Ihoroc yuna Pitaho ‘muno’ yongo inogoc, “Noc amna wo makombing imot.”
Ihoroc yongo wönggon obmukusuc idina amna auho Pita angga yogoc, “Yesuhon toropdecma amna au woi goc ngoroc.” Ihoroc inuna Pitaho yogoc, “Muno, noc yuhon toropdecma muno.”
Ihoroc yuna wönggon aua tungu ihoroc bödeuna amna auho Pitaha mata orongi yogoc, “Boinno sinom amna ngorocho Yesuot itongidoc. Yu Galili amna au.”
Ihoroc yuna Pitaho yogoc, “Muno sinom, imanang yaroc.” Mata woroc yongo idina wohogon fup amnanoho mano yogoc.

Woroc tuna Yesuho ibanda Pita foring auna Pitaho Morömaho mata osuc inogocma worocha kombingga irotno mep tuna böc gombo wo imun fauna taitdec ongga ointogoc. Morömaho wömai Pita osuc mata ingoroc inogoc, “Önga kumbong ngocin fup abe mano mayi idina goc nocha bongo anfi möp yong namontaroc.”
Tawa amnaho Yesu ang yongguto wodung
Oro, tawa amna Yesuha gön tongga idungma yu forosingga Yesuha mata mene inongga wodung.
Tongo yu Yesu daro borudec tom tongmuya woda möp mata ingoroc inogung, “Numaho gotac? Yong tuctuc yoi!”
Ihoroc tongo mata wontucmuno koböcma au inogung.
Tawa amnaho Yesu mata youpdec tohong yugung

Oro kumbongbödeuna isoc isocane surarohon amna dugo yu engsuran togung. Woi öret socsochon amna dugo orin nongoru gendic fandat fandat amna yu engo wocingon suran tuya tawa amnaho Yesu yuho yangamin yangat tonggung.

Yangat tuuya amna morömaho inong ac tongga yogung, “Duic, woi gaka woha muno? Wo tuctugo ninia kombina.” Ihoroc inuya Yesuho yu inogoc, “Nocho son tuctugo kanontatanu wömai son makombing tobing namoning.
O ihorocgon nocho son kanong ac tontatanu wömai sonu urago mananoning.
Worochoi oro, önga forosingga Amnahon Mananoho Gesö Morömo Kopotoroc yuhon obu aroce woce edengoc.”
Ihoroc yuna amna ambaracho yogung, “Ihoroc yarocmaha gocu Kopotorochon Manano itarochu nuhun?” Ihoroc yuya Yesuho yogoc, “Son mata yangma woi boinno.”
Ihoroc yuna yuho yogung, “Oro urop, amna auhon mata makombinin. Yu urop inobut yuna tuctugo kombiamon.”
